pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)The export bus pulls items and fluids (and whatever else, given addons) from $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l) and pushes them into the inventory it's touching.$(br2)For purposes of lag reduction, if the export bus has not exported something recently, it goes into a sort of "sleep mode" where it operates slowly,
and wakes up and accelerates to full speed (4 operations per second) when it successfully exports something.$(br2)They are $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)cable subparts$(/l).

pages.title: Filtering
pages.text: By default the bus will not export anything. Items inserted into its filter slots will act as a whitelist, allowing those specific items to be exported.$(br2)Items and fluids can be dragged into the slots from JEI/REI even if you don't actually have any of that item.$(br2)Right-click with a fluid container (like a bucket or fluid tank) to set that fluid as a filter instead of the bucket

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: The import bus supports the following $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrades$(/l):$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Capacity Card$(/l) increases the amount of filter slots, and brings up a setting on what order to export what is filtered.$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Acceleration Card$(/l) increases the amount of stuff moved per operation$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Fuzzy Card$(/l) lets the bus filter by damage level and/or ignore item NBT$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Crafting Card$(/l) lets the bus send crafting requests to your

$(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l) system to get the items it desires. Can be set to pull the items from storage if possible, or to always make a request for a new item to be crafted.$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Redstone Card$(/l) adds redstone control, allowing active on high signal, low signal, or once per pulse
